title: Local transcriber discovery
summary: Resolve whisper-cli and a local Whisper model, returning a Transcriber or a reason for absence; and whisper-cli's run inside the engine's roughcut, which writes whisper's JSON of the sound it is handed. Discovery invokes no model; the run is the engine's.

carrier.notes: Original: lumeri_runtime.transcriber:resolve_transcriber,library_roots finding whisper-cli, which the engine's roughcut runs inside its own run, named by LUMERI_WHISPER_CLI. Replacement: a lumeri.engine.program/v1 capability with module "lumeri.transcriber.backend", naming an executable file of its Luc, which the engine runs in whisper's place: LUMERI_WHISPER_CLI names it, and the run writes only the session scratch (luc_engine_programs, sandbox.MacOSSandboxExecutor.bind_capability nested, engine_jobs.bind_engine_job).

replaceability.why: A replacement is code. It is one executable file of a Luc that holds engine.program, which Lumeri's review of its exact bytes grants, and it stands in for whisper-cli: the engine runs it with whisper's arguments, environment and sandbox profile, inside the engine's own run, which may write only the session scratch. It runs only on a machine with a sandbox (macOS today) and with whisper.cpp and a model installed (docs/luc/engine-programs.md).
replaceability.decided: today's code: lumeri_runtime/transcriber.py:114-157, gemia/roughcut.py:331-342; Acrab 2026-10-26: replaced by engine programs in the engine's own sandbox

reach.notes: The program reads what whisper may read (the sound in the scratch, the model) and writes only the session scratch; it runs only what whisper may run, with no network. The Runtime checks what it leaves, and keeps the Project, the notes and the events.

operations.name: resolve_transcriber
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Missing binary/model returns absence as data, not an exception. Model precedence: LUMERI_WHISPER_MODEL then the two small-model candidates. No overall timeout; individual otool library lookups enforce 30 seconds.

operations.name: library_roots
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Recursively follows linked libraries. A failed otool lookup is treated as no dependencies; this is not proof of a complete runtime closure.

operations.name: transcribe
operations.notes: The engine's roughcut starts it as `<whisper-cli> -m <model> -f <sound> -ojf -of <output_base> -np -l <language> -ng`, the sound being cache/roughcut-audio.wav (16 kHz mono PCM) of the run's scratch, and reads <output_base>.json, cache/roughcut-whisper.json. It answers with exit status 0 and that file. No deadline of its own: the engine's run, whisper's included, has the profile's 600 s.

events.name: luc.module_fell_back
events.notes: Once per Session in a start: when the module's program broke (gate run), or when its Luc was left off for the module after three breaks (gate load). Codes: E_LUC_ENGINE_START, E_LUC_ENGINE_EXIT, E_LUC_ENGINE_RESULT, E_LUC_ENGINE_LIMIT, E_LUC_ENGINE_DEADLINE, E_LUC_ENGINE_CHANGED.

bounds.name: whisper_slack_ms
bounds.unit: milliseconds a word may end after the sound it was heard in

invariants.text: The sandbox receives canonical resolved executable/model paths and their explicit readable roots.
A transcriber program is no run of its own: it runs only where the engine's run names whisper-cli by LUMERI_WHISPER_CLI, as that run's whisper.
Whisper's own JSON is a transcript; one whose segments or words have no text or offsets, end before they start or after the sound, or whose words' p is no probability, is not.
With a reviewed Luc's program, the roughcut's transcript and notes are the program's words.

When the run with the program breaks, its working files are cleared and the original runs the same roughcut, so whisper reads nothing the program wrote; the original answers for the rest of the start.
A roughcut that fails with the program and fails again with whisper is the request's failure, not a break.

break: the program cannot be placed, or its bytes are not the ones its Luc loaded with

the engine's run with it fails (exits with a status other than 0, outruns the profile's time, memory, process or output limits, or leaves what the Runtime refuses) and the original's run of the same request then answers

the engine's run with it answers, and cache/roughcut-whisper.json is not whisper's JSON: an object with a transcription list whose segments and words have text and offsets inside the sound, and words whose p is a probability
failure.notes: The run's working files are cleared and the original runs the same roughcut at once, and every one of this module for the rest of the start (luc_interactions.note_module_break); three breaks of the same bytes leave the Luc off for the module at later starts until reset (luc_breaker, luc_cli.py modules reset lumeri.transcriber.backend). A failure of the run with the program is weighed against the original's: when that fails too, the request fails and nothing is counted. The creator stopping the request is not a break: the run is stopped and nothing runs in its place.

conformance.notes: tests/test_luc_engine_programs.py holds which runs are the module's, the check on whisper's JSON against whisper's own answer, and, with real compiled programs run by the real engine in the transcription sandbox: a Worker whose roughcut is the program's words, each way of breaking handing the same roughcut to whisper from a clean scratch for the rest of the start, and a roughcut whisper could not do either that is no break.

known_deviations.text: Whisper binary/model discovery checks file existence rather than model integrity or actual transcription. Backend readiness needs separate execution evidence.
A transcriber program runs only where whisper.cpp and a model are installed: a machine without either gets the original's 503 naming what is missing, and a program cannot bring a model of its own.
Where an engine program answers for the roughcut subcommand (lumeri.engine.gemia), it is handed Lumeri's own whisper, not the transcriber program.
A run with the program that fails costs a second run of the roughcut, the original's, each with the profile's 600 s.
